Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Revenue increased in the synthetic 2024 fiscal year. The following table is
intentionally represented with a footnote marker attached to the operating
margin value.

Consolidated Results
Fiscal year       2024       2023
Revenue           1,250      1,100
Operating margin  18.4%[1]  17.1%

[1] The synthetic operating margin includes a fictional one-time adjustment.
